import time
import os
import glob

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application
scan = application.Scan

# Get the current working directory and list files before scan
work_dir = os.getcwd()
print(f"Working directory: {work_dir}")
files_before = set(glob.glob(os.path.join(work_dir, '*.nid')))
print(f"Files before scan: {len(files_before)}")

# Start first scan
print("\n=== Starting Scan 1 ===")
start_time = time.time()
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    if remaining % 20 == 0:  # Print every 20 lines
        print(f"Scanning... Remaining lines: {remaining}")
    time.sleep(1)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

end_time = time.time()
print(f"Scan 1 completed in {end_time - start_time:.2f} seconds")

# Get the new file
time.sleep(1)  # Wait a moment for file to be saved
files_after = set(glob.glob(os.path.join(work_dir, '*.nid')))
new_files = files_after - files_before

if new_files:
    scan1_path = list(new_files)[0]
    print(f"Scan 1 saved to: {scan1_path}")
else:
    print("Warning: No new file detected")
    scan1_path = None

del spm"}</action_input>
